As described above, accepting the PILOT on the entire Project will result in a loss of approximately $82,200 in the first year of the term.

Factoring in the 2% estimated average annual increase in the property tax assessment, the total impact is estimated at $ 4,965,043, forgoing 31.73% of the tax revenue cumulatively over the 40-year period that the PILOT agreement remains in effect.
